description:
How fast the athlete should run, from their own Goblin Gains records:
    with `zone`, the pace their steady runs held at that zone's heart rate
    first; then pace by HR zone from their steady runs, HR zones, critical
    speed and its source, the formula pace zones and training paces, the
    work and recovery bouts of recent interval runs, recent runs with each
    lap's (split's) distance, pace and HR, planned runs, readiness. Needs the
    athlete's key.

minutes.description: How long that run is. Example: 60 for "an hour".
minutes.title: Minutes

zone.description: The HR zone of the run the athlete asks about, 1-5; omitted for all zones. Example: 2 for "a zone 2 run".
zone.title: Zone

name: get_running_paces
title: Get my running paces
